facts.text: The resort is a beachfront hotel on Playa La Ropa in Bahía de Zihuatanejo.
facts.excerpt: our Playa La Ropa beachfront resort hotel feels a world away from bustling Zihuatanejo Centro

facts.text: The resort sits on what was once a secluded fishing village near Ixtapa.
facts.excerpt: At what was once a secluded fishing village

facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed with a mid-century aesthetic using materials and textures indigenous to Playa La Ropa.
facts.excerpt: designed with an elegant mid-century aesthetic honoring materials and textures indigenous to Playa La Ropa

facts.text: Rooms feature deep amber parotta woods, Oaxacan clay light fixtures, brass details and Mexican artwork.
facts.excerpt: deep amber parotta woods, Oaxacan clay light fixtures, brass details and Mexican artwork

facts.text: The Swim Up Suite opens from a private balcony directly into an adults-only pool.
facts.excerpt: Step off a private balcony and directly into an adults-only pool, just a few feet from your back door.

facts.text: Several suites have a private plunge pool on the terrace or balcony.
facts.excerpt: Step off a private terrace or balcony and wade out into a plunge pool isolated by a screen of live palms.

facts.text: The Thompson Suite is a two-bedroom suite with direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: Soak up Playa La Ropa views from our two-bedroom suite with direct beach access.

facts.text: Rooms and suites face garden, lagoon or ocean views.
facts.excerpt: frames a garden, lagoon or ocean view

facts.text: Ceniza, named for the Spanish word for ash, puts a spin on traditional wood-fired cooking under a palm-thatched palapa.
facts.excerpt: Named for the Spanish word for ash, Ceniza puts a spin on traditional wood-fired cooking techniques in this balmy beachfront setting. Under a palm-thatched palapa

facts.text: Ceniza serves a sustainably sourced menu of Mexican surf and turf dishes.
facts.excerpt: enticed by a sustainably-sourced menu of Mexican surf and turf dishes

facts.text: Hao is an oceanfront all-day bar serving seasonal ingredients in modern Mexican style.
facts.excerpt: you’ll enjoy seasonal ingredients prepared in modern Mexican style at this oceanfront all-day bar

facts.text: On Saturdays Hao hosts a beachfront taco experience with handmade rolled tortillas.
facts.excerpt: Saturday Taco Experience: Settle into a beachfront location

facts.text: On Thursdays Hao holds a grill-out of seafood and meats grilled oceanside with live music.
facts.excerpt: Thursday HAO Grill Out: Enjoy fresh seafood and premium cuts of meat, displayed and selected to be grilled oceanside

facts.text: La Parota is the resort's 'Dinner in the Wild', where smoke is the base for all dishes.
facts.excerpt: the base for all dishes is smoke, with nuances of haute cuisine and primitive techniques

facts.text: The resort has two tennis courts, with racquets and balls provided.
facts.excerpt: two beautifully maintained tennis courts, designed for both casual play and dedicated practice. We provide racquets and balls for your convenience.

facts.text: The fitness center is surrounded by tropical gardens and has Peloton bikes.
